The Crimson Sparks - Album 4: Ignite - Catching Fire

Relearn

"I’m gonna relearn how to laugh without the ache"

[Verse 1 - quiet, just starting to breathe again] I’ve been sitting with the wreckage for a while Learning how to walk before I learn to smile I know the shape of every scar by heart But scars are just the proof I didn’t fall apart

I lost myself somewhere between the noise and night Between the static and the doors I kept locked tight I wore so many faces I forgot my own But something in the silence said it’s time to come back home

[Pre-Chorus - building, first spark of fire] I’m not who I was before the crash I’m not the ashes, I’m not the past I’m something in between that I don’t know yet But I’m done being afraid of what comes next

[Chorus - full anthem, arms wide open] I’m gonna relearn how to laugh without the ache Relearn every chance I was too scared to take Relearn how to trust what I tried to erase Relearn how to meet my own reflection face to face This isn’t the end—it’s a clearer view A step back into something honest, something true And the only thing left I can see Is relearn Relearn Me

[Verse 2 - stronger now, finding footing] I used to think that breaking meant the end Turns out it’s just the place where I begin The faceless girl, the spinning bottle, gone I know my face now and I’m carrying on

I pressed my ear against my own locked door And heard a voice I hadn’t heard before She said “I’ve been here waiting, where have you been?” Turns out the strongest thing I had was just within

[Pre-Chorus 2] I’m not who I was before it broke I’m not the ruins or the smoke I’m something still becoming—I’ll figure it out yet And I’m done being afraid of what comes next

[Chorus 2] I will relearn laughter, light and unconfined Relearn trust before I run out of time Relearn all the parts I left buried deep Relearn the rhythm of the soul I couldn’t keep I’m not beginning—I’m breaking through Returning to a self I always knew And all that’s left for me to be Is relearn Relearn Me

[Bridge - spoken almost, then rising] They say you can’t go back And that is true But you can go forward As someone new Someone who knows what the dark tastes like And chose the light anyway Someone who fell all the way down And got up And said…

[Final Chorus - biggest moment, full band, pure release] I’m gonna relearn how to stand without the fear Relearn every reason I am here Relearn every scar and call it mine with pride Relearn how to let the fire back inside I’m not starting over, I’m starting real The best thing that I feel Is learning Relearning Me
